svg.title: A child's eyes: the red reflex sorts a dim or different reflex (refractive error or media opacity), a brighter one (the turned eye in strabismus) and a white one (leukocoria, retinoblastoma first); misaligned eyes are concomitant or incomitant by whether the angle changes with gaze; reduced acuity in one eye without disease is amblyopia; each column gives what is seen, what to think of and what to do, with retinoblastoma (genetics, treatment, outcome) in the leukocoria column
